items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability leading to Account Takeover
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 9.1) in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source allows unauthenticated attackers to switch customer sessions, hijack accounts, and escalate privileges. Exploitation attempts have been detected in the wild.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Security Feature Bypass)
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability allows a security-feature bypass without requiring authentication or administrator privileges. This was addressed in the APSB26-92 security update.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability in Adobe Commerce B2B
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B could enable a security-feature bypass. Exploitation requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability could result in arbitrary code execution. It requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Multiple Vulnerabilities including Arbitrary Code Execution and Privilege Escalation
items.summary: This security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities. Successful exploitation could lead to security feature bypass, application denial-of-service, privilege escalation, arbitrary code execution, and arbitrary file system read.

items.title: Critical Vulnerability Leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: Adobe released a security update resolving a critical vulnerability that, if successfully exploited, could lead to arbitrary code execution.

items.title: Multiple Vulnerabilities including Arbitrary Code Execution and File System Write
items.summary: A security update addresses critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, arbitrary file system write, application denial-of-service, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Security Feature Bypass)
items.summary: A medium-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability could enable a security-feature bypass. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Privilege Escalation)
items.summary: A low-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability could result in privilege escalation. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Unrestricted File Upload via REST API
items.summary: Sansec discovered a critical flaw in Magento's REST API allowing unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files disguised as images. While a fix is in Magento 2.4.9, older supported versions remain vulnerable without backports.
